text.title: CLAUDE.md Creation (Quality) — Worked Examples
text.summary: One complete record for a multi-package platform repository whose root CLAUDE.md fits an 84-of-100 line budget with three subdirectory files, with a note on every value a reader might question, and one record for the 480-line first draft that breaks all eight subject rules and what the validator and the reviewer say about it.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: `acme/platform` holds an API, a web app and infrastructure in one repository. Its first CLAUDE.md was 480 lines: the README pasted in, `cd apps/api && pytest` and `cd apps/web && pnpm test` side by side, a connection string "so Claude can run the migration", and IMPORTANT on most lines. The tech lead runs steps 1-9 of `content/04-procedure.xml` and merges the file whose record is below.

section.title: Good example: 84 lines of 100, three subdirectory files

example.title: Complete record with reviewer
example.note: `root_file.line_count` 84 against a declared budget of 100: the per-package commands that made the first draft 480 lines now live in `apps/api/CLAUDE.md`, `apps/web/CLAUDE.md` and `infra/CLAUDE.md`, and the root carries only the three `pnpm turbo` invocations that run across the workspace.
Every command is the exact invocation including `--frozen-lockfile` and the turbo filter; each exited 0 in CI run 5120, the first evidence URL.
`imports.entries` are `CONTRIBUTING.md` at one hop and the ADR index at two; the README is no longer pasted, and nothing sits past the five-hop limit.

Three prohibitions, each with its consequence in the same line; only the `/srv/app` one is emphasised because violating it overwrites a deploy target. `emphasis_ratio` 0.04 is far under the one-in-four ceiling.
`secrets.runs_in_pre_commit` is true as well as CI: the rule wants the scan before the commit exists, not only after the push.
`reviewer` is `tl:mreyes`, a person; the schema rejects a team handle because the human checkpoint is a named approval.

example.title: Eight subject rules broken
example.note: What the validator prints: `root_file.budget_declared_in_first_comment: False`, `within_budget: False`, `ci_line_check: False` (r-claude-md-line-budget); `secrets.runs_in_pre_commit: False`, `clean: False`, `referenced_by_name_only: False` (r-claude-md-no-secrets); `commands[0].invocation: 'run the tests' matches the forbidden not schema`, `verbatim: False`, `exit_code: 1 is not the required const 0` (r-claude-md-commands-verbatim); `imports.pasted_repo_content: True` and `entries[0].hop_depth: 6 is above maximum 5` (r-claude-md-import-not-paste); `local_scope.personal_content_in_committed_file: True` and `claude_local_md_gitignored: False` (r-claude-md-personal-goes-local); `<root>: missing required field: subdir_files` and `root_has_per_package_commands: True` for a multi-package layout (r-claude-md-subdir-scoping); `prohibitions[0].consequence_stated: False` and `emphasis_ratio: 0.6 is above maximum 0.25` (r-claude-md-prohibitions-argued); `refs_check.all_refs_exist: False` (r-claude-md-refs-exist); `reviewer: 'team:platform'` fails the handle pattern's person requirement in review even though the pattern admits it.

What the reviewer sees beyond the validator: the secret scan hit is a connection string already in git history, so the credential is rotated before the file is touched (fm-secret-in-brief); and the 480 lines are the README plus three packages' commands, so steps 3 and 5 of the procedure fix the budget as a side effect. The draft goes back to step 1.

list.item: The budget is met by moving content, not by deleting the commands: imports and subdirectory files are where the lines go.
Pre-commit is where the secret scan pays for itself; CI catches the leak after it is already in a pushed commit.
A prohibition with its consequence attached is a constraint the agent can weigh; emphasis works only while it is rare.
